bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 159 (Friday, September 29, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mrs. RAMIREZ:
H.R. 5827.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The Congress shall have power to lay and collect taxes,
duties, imposts and excises, to pay the debts and provide for
the common defense and general welfare of the United States
The single subject of this legislation is:
Provides for tenants' right to organize and participate in
resident organizations and to be free from retaliation.
[Page H4910]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Tenants’ Right to Organize Act
